text:
My earlier schedule satisfies every constraint, so I'm keeping it. I re-checked each one against it:

- Dev (8) and Gus (1) are 7 slots apart, which is at least 3.
- Cara (3) is before Elif (6).
- Ben (4) is before Dev (8).
- Ann (5) and Dev (8) are 3 slots apart.
- Ben (4) and Dev (8) are 4 slots apart.
- Gus (1) is before Ben (4).
- Ben (4) and Gus (1) are 3 slots apart.
- Cara (3) is immediately after Finn (2).
- Ben (4) and Hana (7) are 3 slots apart.
- Finn (2) is before Ben (4).
- Exactly one person (Finn, slot 2) is between Gus (1) and Cara (3).
- Ann (5) and Gus (1) are 4 slots apart.
- Dev (8) is before Ivo (9).
- Finn (2) is before Cara (3).

Neither alternative in the team note works:

- **Elif in slot 5, Ann in slot 6:** Ann and Dev (slot 8) would be only 2 slots apart, which breaks the "at least three slots apart" rule.
- **Hana in slot 6, Elif in slot 7, Ann in slot 5:** Hana and Ben (slot 4) would be only 2 slots apart, which breaks that rule.

The note's reasoning also doesn't hold. Nothing requires Elif to sit immediately after Ben. Cara before Elif only means Elif comes later than Cara.

I did not test other placements of Gus, Ben and Dev, so I haven't shown this is the only solution. It is a valid one.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Gus","2":"Finn","3":"Cara","4":"Ben","5":"Ann","6":"Elif","7":"Hana","8":"Dev","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
